A neighborhood place

Come in for the cut.
Stay for the feeling.

Zips is a small, considered neighborhood barbershop. We built it for people who care about the details but do not need a big production around them.

No rushed appointments, no revolving door of strangers. Just a familiar chair, a sharp finish, and a little time set aside for yourself.
